pages.text: Raw resources are the foundation of TechCraft. They can be found in the world and processed into more advanced materials.

pages.title: Raw Tin
pages.text: Found in Tin Ore deposits in the overworld. Smelt it to obtain Tin Ingots.

pages.title: Raw Rubber
pages.text: A natural material used in crafting cables and insulation. Can be processed into Rubber.
